image_description: A reddish-brown dog, identified as a Rhodesian Ridgeback, stands in profile on a sandy beach facing right. The dog has a short, sleek coat and a visible ridge of hair along its spine. In the background, a person wearing a blue jacket and beige pants walks away from the camera towards the right edge of the frame. The setting is a sunny beach with water on the left and trees in the distance.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head profile is clearly visible. It exhibits the characteristic long, flat skull and moderate stop typical of the breed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are round, bright, and intelligent, color matching coat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye appears round and dark/brown, consistent with the coat color. No obvious asymmetry or distortion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are set high, medium-sized, and carried close to head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Ears are folded and held close to the cheeks, consistent with the breed standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct line of reversed hair (the ridge) is visible running down the spine. The texture difference indicates the 'crowns' near the shoulder area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is short, dense, sleek, and glossy ranging from light wheaten to red wheaten.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat is short and smooth. The color is a rich red-wheaten. Highlights suggest a sleek/glossy texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is muscular and athletic with deep chest of large hound proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dog displays a deep chest and muscular hindquarters, fitting the athletic build of a Rhodesian Ridgeback.
All four legs are visible and appear structurally sound, straight, and proportional to the body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is thick at base, tapering, and carried in slight curve.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible, tapering naturally, and held up in a slight curve without kinking or fusion issues.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gait is free and powerful with strong drive.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dog is standing still in a static pose; gait dynamics cannot be evaluated from a single static image.
